title: [Feature Request] Add stream response mode configuration for cumulative or delta content
body:
### Required prerequisites

- [x] I have searched the [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/discussions) that this hasn't already been reported. (+1 or comment there if it has.)
- [ ] Consider asking first in a [Discussion](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/discussions/new).

### Motivation

Currently, the streaming response logic in `ChatAgent` always returns the accumulated content with each chunk. If the stream contains many chunks, the response body will grow larger and larger, resulting in bandwidth waste and increased memory pressure.
It would be beneficial to add a configuration option (e.g., `stream_accumulate_mode`) to allow users to choose between returning accumulated content (`accumulate`, the current behavior) or only the incremental content (`delta`) for each chunk. This enhancement would make the system more flexible and efficient for different use cases.

### Solution

1. Add a `stream_accumulate_mode` parameter to the `ChatAgent` class (default: `accumulate`).
2. Update the `StreamContentAccumulator` and streaming response logic to use this configuration, so the agent can return either accumulated content or only the new content for each chunk.

### Alternatives

_No response_

### Additional context

_No response_

## Description

- Introduces a configurable streaming mode to return either accumulated content (default) or only deltas per chunk, reducing bandwidth and memory for long streams.
- Optimizes the streaming accumulator to append fragments and join once, lowering allocation overhead.

Fixes #3134
